name: Smarthome Place Pattern
description: To represent a SmartHome as a place (specialization of http://www.ontologydesignpatterns.org/ont/dul/DUL.owl#PhysicalPlace) which contains a number of sections (other physical places) and is also seen as a platform (e.g. a platform for a sensor network).
competency_questions: What are the spatial/directional relations between sections of a smart home?; Which physical objects are located in a section of a smart environment?; How many and what sections are there in the SmartHome?
